evidence_snippets: If the number is blocked, and the caller is calling into a UK number from a phone number with a US country code, the callback won't take place since there will be an incorrect number stored for the caller [UK +44 (extracted from inbound IVR number + consumer entered number].

Restrict outbound calling for special service numbers Admins can configure dedicated restrictions for special service phone numbers so that only agents, teams, or locations allowed for the special service number can make calls to that number.
Giving agents the opportunity to add an area code to a phone number is particularly important in cases when the area code isn't included in the CRM record.
